_comment: GTA:SA executables recognized by satk (docs/en/game.md). Only values confirmed by a
source are listed: 'source' names it (research reports live in the workspace docs/research/, Neon =
src/mtasa-neon, plugin-sdk = src/plugin-sdk-sa, gta-reversed = src/gta-reversed; all read-only).
layout '1.0us' = the address layout of the satk re symbol DB; supported = satk re works with it.
Matching order: variants (exact sha256) -> signatures (u32 at a virtual address, read from the file
through the PE section table; plugin-sdk checks memory, so a packed retail exe may not match) -> sizes.
Signature and size matches are reported as heuristic.
Not listed for lack of verified data: hashes/sizes of 1.0 EU, 1.01, 2.0, Steam 3.0 and the Rockstar
Games Launcher build, and the MTA ProgramData variant aero=0/optimus=1 (5b01125d..., only in satk.game.exe).
